tool.name: read_file
tool.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Only works within allowed directories.

tool.name: write_file
tool.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning.

tool.name: list_directory
tool.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

tool.name: search_files
tool.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Returns full paths to all matching items.

tool.name: get_file_info
tool.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory, including size, creation time, last modified time and permissions.

tool.name: create_issue
tool.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository.

tool.name: list_pull_requests
tool.description: List pull requests in a GitHub repository with optional filters for state, head and base branch.

tool.name: get_file_contents
tool.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository.

tool.name: create_pull_request
tool.description: Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

tool.name: search_code
tool.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories using GitHub code search syntax.

tool.name: slack_post_message
tool.description: Post a new message to a Slack channel.

tool.name: slack_list_channels
tool.description: List public channels in the workspace with pagination.

tool.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tool.description: Get all replies in a message thread.

tool.name: send_email
tool.description: Send an email to one or more recipients. Supports plain text and HTML bodies.

tool.name: search_emails
tool.description: Search emails in the mailbox using a query string. Returns matching message ids and snippets.

tool.name: query
tool.description: Run a read only SQL query against the connected Postgres database and return rows as JSON.

tool.name: list_tables
tool.description: List all tables in the current database schema.

tool.name: describe_table
tool.description: Return column names, types and constraints for a table.

tool.name: fetch
tool.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and optionally extracts its contents as markdown. Use this when you need up to date information from the web.

tool.name: brave_web_search
tool.description: Performs a web search using the Brave Search API, ideal for general queries, news and articles. Use this for broad information gathering.

tool.name: get_weather
tool.description: Get the current weather and a 3 day forecast for a city.

tool.name: create_event
tool.description: Create a calendar event with a title, start time, end time and optional attendees.

tool.name: list_events
tool.description: List upcoming calendar events between two dates.

tool.name: create_page
tool.description: Create a new page in a Notion workspace under the given parent page.

tool.name: search_notion
tool.description: Search pages and databases in Notion by title.

tool.name: jira_create_ticket
tool.description: Create a Jira ticket in the given project with a summary and description.

tool.name: stripe_list_charges
tool.description: List recent Stripe charges for the connected account. Amounts are in cents.

tool.name: stripe_create_refund
tool.description: Refund a Stripe charge fully or partially. Requires the charge id.

tool.name: git_status
tool.description: Shows the working tree status of a local git repository.

tool.name: git_diff
tool.description: Shows differences between the working tree and the index, or between commits.

tool.name: git_commit
tool.description: Records changes to the repository with a commit message.

tool.name: puppeteer_navigate
tool.description: Navigate the headless browser to a URL.

tool.name: puppeteer_screenshot
tool.description: Take a screenshot of the current page or a specific element.

tool.name: memory_create_entities
tool.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph.

tool.name: memory_search_nodes
tool.description: Search for nodes in the knowledge graph based on a query.

tool.name: sentry_get_issue
tool.description: Retrieve and analyze a Sentry issue by id, including stack traces.

tool.name: translate_text
tool.description: Translate text between languages. Source language is detected automatically.

tool.name: summarize_document
tool.description: Summarize a long document into key points. Keeps the original language.

tool.name: load_env_config
tool.description: Load application settings from environment variables and report which required settings are missing. Values are never returned, only names.

tool.name: rotate_api_key
tool.description: Rotate the service API key in the secrets manager. The new key is stored in the vault and never shown in the response.

tool.name: get_system_prompt_template
tool.description: Return the named prompt template from the prompt library so editors can review it.

tool.name: send_sms
tool.description: Send an SMS message to a phone number in E.164 format. Charges apply per segment.

tool.name: kubectl_get_pods
tool.description: List pods in a Kubernetes namespace with their status.

tool.name: run_tests
tool.description: Run the project test suite and return a summary of passed and failed tests.

tool.name: youtube_transcript
tool.description: Fetch the transcript of a YouTube video by URL.
